name: dForce USD
oneLiner: USX was dForce's CDP-style stablecoin, frozen in July 2026 after legacy dForce/Unitus debt left it near $0.39 with no credible par-redemption route.

obituary.epitaph: Overcollateralized on paper, unredeemable in practice
obituary.obituary: USX was dForce's CDP-style stablecoin, launched in 2021 and peaking above $205M in mid-2022. It never fully recovered the peg after the 2022 bear market: legacy debt positions on the dForce/Unitus lending protocol left circulating USX without a credible par-redemption route, and the discount widened from cents to a chasm. The terminal slide came in early 2026 — below $0.75 in February, below $0.45 by April, and roughly $0.39 by July — with on-chain liquidity measured in tens of thousands of dollars and daily volume under $10. With the DF governance token near zero, no published remediation plan, and no redemption at par, Pharos froze USX as a collapsed archive asset.

collateral: dForce/Unitus stablecoin reserves and overcollateralized crypto positions; docs describe USDT, USDC, DAI and protocol collateral routes
pegMechanism: USX is minted and redeemed through dForce/Unitus stablecoin and lending routes, with sUSX as a separate yield-bearing wrapper

oracleRisk.summary: dForce says Chainlink Price Feeds are the primary oracle solution for its lending and stablecoin protocols, with no stronger USX-specific failover documented.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: dForce documents USX as its protocol stablecoin across supported chains. No independent bridge protocol was resolved in the review, so the route is treated as dForce-managed native multichain issuance rather than third-party bridge supply.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Bounded unknown retained: dForce documentation and tracked EVM deployments establish USX's multi-chain scope and upstream reserve exposure, but do not establish a complete holder-level blacklist or freeze inventory across all routes.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: USX is tracked across Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Polygon, Kava, and Avalanche deployments. The reviewed dForce sources establish the asset scope but do not prove deployment-wide holder-control behavior; inherited exposure is not treated as a direct USX blacklist.

mintAuthority.summary: USX is minted via dForce/Unitus overcollateralized borrow routes; all on-chain controls (token owner, proxy admin, minter) trace to a 3-of-5 Gnosis Safe through a nominal executor contract (no enforced time delay).

controls.label: USX MSD token minter registry
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25,294,715: implementation = 0xe3ec7de9375bfc22f4481c4605431d67ed5bd260, owner() = 0x17e66B1e0260C930bfA567ff3ab5c71794279b94 (executor contract), proxy admin = 0x4ff0455bcfbb5886607c078e0f43efb5de34def4, getMinters() = [0x45677a101D70E9910C418D9426bC6c5874CE2Fd7] (EIP-1967 proxy, also owned by executor).

controls.label: USX token owner / executor contract
controls.evidence: Custom executor contract (labelled 'Timelock' in errors but bytecode has NO timestamp/ETA enforcement — calls execute immediately). owner() (slot 0) = 0x145c79A1F0e1Ad5ad7fC8d99548a02A07B24F8FD (3-of-5 Gnosis Safe). Also owns proxy admin 0x4ff0455… and minter 0x45677a…

controls.label: dForce governance multisig (3-of-5 Gnosis Safe)
controls.evidence: On-chain getOwners()/getThreshold() at block 25,294,715: Gnosis Safe v1.3.0, 3-of-5, nonce 136, no modules, no guard. Controls executor 0x17e66… which owns token, proxy admin, and minter. No enforced time delay.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25,294,715: full governance chain confirmed — token/proxy admin/minter all owned by executor 0x17e66… → owned by 3-of-5 Gnosis Safe 0x145c79… (no modules, nonce 136). Executor has no timestamp/ETA enforcement; actions execute immediately upon 3-of-5 approval.

reserveReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 backing review
reserveReview.rationale: dForce describes USX as overcollateralized by crypto assets and as supporting 1:1 minting and redemption with USDT, USDC, and DAI. The reviewed issuer documentation does not publish a current asset allocation, collateral balances, named custody providers, or liability reconciliation, so the complete envelope is represented as one mixed pool rather than an unsupported split.

notices.title: Frozen after irrecoverable depeg
notices.message: USX collapsed to roughly $0.39 with negligible on-chain liquidity, reflecting legacy debt positions on the dForce/Unitus protocol with no credible par-redemption route. Pharos froze USX on 2026-07-18; data below is a read-only archive.
